subject.title: feat: allow skipping hybrid memory CLI plugin

question: Should `cli-metadata.*` remain the supported lightweight entry convention for external plugins, or should OpenClaw expose an explicit manifest field for that entry?
rationale: The repository already has the required generic behavior, but its stable public representation should be confirmed before external plugins are directed to depend on it long term.

options.title: Document current convention
options.body: Treat `cli-metadata.*` as supported plugin surface, document it, and have hybrid-memory provide that lightweight entry.

options.title: Add manifest entry field
options.body: Expose a typed CLI metadata entry in the plugin manifest and migrate the loader and external plugin to that explicit contract.

options.title: Accept plugin exception
options.body: Keep the generic contract implicit and support this external plugin through a process-wide core environment-variable special case.

recommendation.title: Document current convention
recommendation.body: Treat `cli-metadata.*` as supported plugin surface, document it, and have hybrid-memory provide that lightweight entry.

likelyOwner.reason: The current dedicated CLI metadata loader and CLI registry split originate in their recent work.
